examples.explanation: The longest piece using at most two distinct characters is "ece".
The longest piece using at most two distinct characters is "aabbb".
A single character trivially uses one distinct character.

hints: Keep a sliding window with counts of each character inside it.
When the window holds more than two distinct characters, move the left edge forward until it holds two again.
title: 312. Longest Substring with At Most Two Distinct Characters
